admission.justification: The standalone route case publishes and validates coherence and reaches closeout readiness; the fingerprint case keeps every sprint case unchanged.

applicability: A task of a master that no sprint commands.
conditions: The master's null sprint gives its projection no authored graph, and the projection is placed as an atomic-sequential master.
The task is its direct child.
exclusions: A task of a sprint-commanded master, whose topology carries the sprint and authored graph.
The closeout door and closeout_queue, which remain unrepaired under M7 and still refuse a sprint-less master.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_standalone_master_route.py; mcp/tests/test_semantic_topology_standalone.py; mcp/tests/test_role_launch_routes.py::StandaloneMasterSelectionTests::test_the_set_selections_admit_a_leaf_of_a_standalone_master; expanded evidence §2.8 (curator_coherence published on the post-repair server, memory_quality_check closeoutReady true, closeout apply + integrate landed 29a8f26 and 28bcec8 on ar/sbx-m7; the closeout door and queue were never called)

statement: curator_coherence publishes and validates for a task of a master that no sprint commands, and memory_quality_check reaches closeout-ready for it.
